High byte of the first map command address, followed by the four remaining command addresses.

Clear the current object's active slot, decrement $FE51 and call the tile restoration path before adding the first six-digit score increment.

Scan 20 columns by nine rows at the current map origin and draw each tile into the gameplay display.
